data.name: Path Nodes

events.name: CPI
events.context: Core inflation came in below the expected pace. Equities rose as Treasury yields eased after the release.

events.name: Tesla
events.context: Automotive margins disappointed despite higher deliveries. The earnings call focused on pricing and the cost of new vehicle programs.

events.name: Visa
events.context: Payment volumes remained firm and cross-border activity supported revenue. Management maintained its outlook.

events.name: Boeing
events.context: Working capital and delivery timing weighed on cash generation. Investors focused on the path back to positive free cash flow.

events.name: Microsoft
events.context: Cloud growth exceeded expectations and demand remained strong. Investors weighed that growth against higher infrastructure investment.

events.name: Alphabet
events.context: Search advertising and cloud revenue improved. Management discussed how AI products are changing engagement and infrastructure spending.

events.name: Meta
events.context: Advertising growth held up, but the investment outlook was higher than expected. The reaction reflected concern about the timing of returns on that spending.

events.name: ServiceNow
events.context: Subscription growth exceeded expectations and contracted revenue expanded. The next question is how that demand converts into renewals.

events.name: Ford
events.context: Warranty costs pressured margins. Management outlined the operational changes it expects to improve profitability.

events.name: UPS
events.context: Lower shipping volumes weighed on operating leverage. The outlook depends on demand and cost reductions.

events.name: US GDP
events.context: The growth estimate exceeded expectations, led by consumer demand. Equities moved higher during the first half hour after release.

events.name: Amazon
events.context: Watch AWS growth, retail margins and the capital spending outlook.

events.name: Intel
events.context: Watch product margins, foundry spending and the next-quarter outlook.

events.name: Robinhood
events.context: Watch trading activity, deposits and revenue per customer.

events.name: Apple
events.context: Watch iPhone demand, services growth and the outlook for the holiday quarter.

events.name: Exxon Mobil
events.context: Watch refining margins, production and capital returns.

events.name: Chevron
events.context: Watch production, integration costs and cash generation.

events.name: Core PCE
events.context: Watch the monthly pace of core inflation and revisions to the previous release.

events.name: Employment costs
events.context: Watch private-sector wage and benefit growth for signs of persistent labor cost pressure.

events.name: ISM manufacturing
events.context: Watch new orders, employment and prices paid alongside the headline index.

events.name: Palantir
events.context: Watch commercial growth and whether contracts are converting into revenue.

events.name: FOMC decision
events.context: The rate decision and policy statement arrive first. The press conference is a separate event because its market reaction can differ.

events.name: Fed press conference
events.context: Watch the discussion of inflation progress, employment and the path of future policy decisions.

events.name: Qualcomm
events.context: Watch handset demand, licensing revenue and diversification beyond phones.

events.name: NVIDIA
events.context: Watch data-center growth, gross margins, supply and the next-quarter outlook.
